rows.note: Use this for a professional entertainer or performer in the entertainment industry.

example.english: They are a very popular performer.
example.traditional: 佢係一個好受歡迎嘅藝人。
example.jyutping: keoi5 hai6 jat1 go3 hou2 sau6 fun1 jing4 ge3 ngai6 jan4

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose term for someone performing for an audience, especially when the specific type of performer is not stated.

example.english: The performer will go on stage at eight.
example.traditional: 嗰位表演者八點鐘上台。
example.jyutping: go2 wai2 biu2 jin2 ze2 baat3 dim2 zung1 soeng5 toi4
